attr.title: Arcanum Community Edition
attr.desc: A steampunk isometric RPG from Troika Games where you can freely mix magic and technology.
attr.desc_md: A steampunk isometric RPG from Troika Games where you can freely mix magic and technology. Ported via [Arcanum Community Edition](https://github.com/alexbatalov/arcanum-ce), a clean-room reimplementation of the original engine.
attr.inst: Copy your own purchased Arcanum data files (tig.dat, arcanum1-4.dat, modules/) into the port's arcanumce/gamedata folder before launching. See README for details.
attr.inst_md: You must own Arcanum (GOG or Steam) and copy its data files into `arcanumce/gamedata/` on the device before launching: `tig.dat`, `arcanum1.dat` through `arcanum4.dat`, and the `modules/` folder.
